services.name: Lead Generation & Skip Tracing

services.seoDescription: Motivated seller lists from county records: tax delinquent, probate, code violation and vacant property leads, skip traced with XLeads and DealMachine.
services.promise: Fresh seller lists from public records, cleaned and skip traced for your next campaign.
services.overviewTitle: A caller is only as good as the list.
overview: Dialing old or poorly targeted records burns hours on wrong numbers, disconnected lines and owners with no reason to sell. Good lists start with signals of motivation and end with clean, current contact details.

We pull records from public sources such as tax delinquency, probate, code violation and vacancy data, add for-sale-by-owner listings, and skip trace them through XLeads and DealMachine. Records are cleaned and de-duplicated before they reach a dialer. On Scale, lists are stacked so owners who show up on more than one signal get priority.

On Growth and Scale, list pulling runs every month so your callers always have fresh records. Before calling, lists are screened against national and applicable state Do Not Call lists, as described in our Compliance Policy.

Your current lists have high wrong-number or duplicate rates
You want lists built around motivation signals, not just equity
You would rather not manage data subscriptions and skip tracing yourself

services.name: Comps & Deal Analysis
services.seoTitle: Real Estate Comps & Deal Analysis (MAO, ARV) for Investors | VoloLeads
services.seoDescription: Comparable sales, repair estimates based on square footage and MAO/LAO offer math for wholesalers and real estate investors, delivered on qualified leads.
services.promise: Know your numbers before you make an offer.
services.overviewTitle: The profit is made at the offer.
overview: A qualified seller is only an opportunity if the numbers work. Offer too high and the margin disappears. Offer too low and another buyer gets the deal.

We pull comparable sales, prepare repair estimates based on square footage using a rehab cost calculator, and calculate your maximum and lowest allowable offers (MAO and LAO). You get a short deal recap with the numbers and the assumptions behind them, so your acquisitions team can review it before getting back to the seller.
Comps are delivered as soon as a lead is qualified and submitted, while the seller conversation is still fresh.
fit: Your team spends hours running comps on every lead
You want consistent offer math across your acquisition reps
You are entering a new market and want a second set of eyes on values
youProvide: The property address and seller notes for each qualified lead
